summary:
LUNE is an interactive lunar mission planning tool for exploring and comparing potential landing sites. We developed a web app with a textured 3D Moon, where users can select locations, compare sites, and examine conditions across a mission timeline. Its analysis estimates sunlight and terrain shading, solar panel output, Earth visibility, and communication availability, using lunar position calculations and elevation data.

Planning around these conditions can help identify sites that balance power, surface access, and communication opportunities. LUNE brings these factors together in one visual workspace, making lunar site tradeoffs easier to explore and understand. It supports early mission planning and education; its calculations are estimates, not certified spacecraft predictions.
details:
LUNE is an interactive lunar landing-site planner. Users select locations on a textured 3D Moon, save and compare candidate sites, choose a mission date range, and explore how local conditions change over time. For each site, the app estimates solar visibility, terrain obstruction, solar-panel output, Earth visibility, and communication availability. Its backend combines lunar position calculations with elevation data to model surface horizons and site conditions.

The project helps make complex site tradeoffs easier to see in one workspace. It is designed to support early mission-planning discussions and public understanding of the factors that affect lunar operations; its results are estimates, not certified mission predictions.

Our creative approach combines an interactive globe with mission timelines, comparison views, and practical surface and power analyses. We considered terrain and sunlight, panel tilt and efficiency, communication opportunities, mission timing, and the coverage and resolution limits of available elevation data.

We built LUNE with React and TypeScript, using Three.js and React Three Fiber for the 3D view. The analysis backend uses Python, FastAPI, NumPy, Rasterio, and PyProj. The development stack includes Vite.
